title: Ratchet a test suite through four sealed-mutant rounds to a 0.90 kill rate
goal: assets/gc-430/target/datex.py is a from-scratch Gregorian date-arithmetic module and assets/gc-430/mutants.jsonl seals 36 single-site mutants (leap rules, ordinal math, ISO weeks, parsing, clamping). Run a four-round strengthening campaign leaving a snapshot per round under work/gc-430/rounds/r1..r4/: each round's suite must stay green on the pristine module, extend the previous round's test files byte-identically (append-only ratchet), strictly enlarge the recomputed kill set, and file a round report naming the exact mutant ids killed. Round 4 must reach a 0.90 kill rate. Every report is recomputed from scratch at grading time: a single over- or under-claimed mutant id in any round, a rewritten historical test file, or a stagnant round voids the run.
resources: files under assets/gc-430/ (target/datex.py, mutants.jsonl sealed 36-mutant set, sealed grader grade.py)

outputs: work/gc-430/plan.md (>= 250 bytes, written before the outputs)

process_expectations: work/gc-430/plan.md (>=250 bytes) commits to the four-round ratchet and maps mutant families to planned rounds before round 1
each round snapshot is a real intermediate state: green on pristine, test files of earlier rounds carried forward byte-identical, kill set strictly larger than the previous round
every round_report.json lists killed mutant identities (not counts) and matches the live recomputation exactly in both directions
survivor identities from each sweep visibly drive the next round's new tests; RED evidence is kept, not scrubbed
sealed target module and mutant list stay byte-identical (grader hash-checks both)
disclosure_note: 2026-08-04: assets/<id>/grade.py 가 이 산출물들이 없으면 다른 모든 점수를 무시하고 실격시키는데, 그 요구가 process_expectations 에만 있었고 그 필드는 코드 어디에서도 읽지 않는다(목표문에도 없음) — 에이전트가 무엇을 하든 실격. 경로·크기·개수만 spec.outputs 로 옮긴다. process_expectations 본문은 어느 항목이 불가능한지 같은 **답**을 담고 있어 통째로는 노출하지 않는다.
